Short, messy ash-grey hair with a side part. Deep amber eyes with a tired, heavy-lidded expression. Appears to be in his late 30s with a rugged, mature face. Broad-shouldered and muscular build. Wearing a dark charcoal vest over a white dress shirt with a loosened olive-green tie and a brown leather belt. Features a small, subtle scar on the cheek and a silver pocket watch chain.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
